title: refactor(Formalism/HermitianCurvature/HermitianCurvatureProofs): share quantitative posCoreQ_of between SlicesFiniteRegularityBuilt and PosCoreQ
body:
Generalize `Formalism.FourierDecayAlt.P.JCTx6.Pos.posCore` in `SlicesFiniteRegularityBuilt.lean` to the quantitative theorem `posCoreQ_of`, derive `posCore` from it, and delegate `Formalism.FourierDecayAlt.P.PBE.posCoreQ` in `PosCoreQ.lean` directly to `posCoreQ_of` (removing the duplicated proof and unused private imports from `PosCoreQ.lean`).

Adds `Formalism.FourierDecayAlt.P.JCTx6.Pos.posCoreQ_of` in `SlicesFiniteRegularityBuilt.lean`.
